hero.name: Prashant Shrestha
hero.description: I'm a .NET backend developer in Kathmandu with nearly 4 years of experience, counting my internship. I build ERP modules, mobile APIs and reporting dashboards for real businesses, mainly with C#, ASP.NET (.NET Framework 4.8.1), Web API and MS SQL Server, and I integrate them with AngularJS frontends. I have also worked on Next Coach, an online mentorship platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL. I care about clean, maintainable code, fast queries, and secure, reliable software.

about.heading: About Me
about.name: Prashant Shrestha
about.role: .NET Backend Developer | ASP.NET, C#, MS SQL
about.intro: I'm a backend developer from Kathmandu, Nepal. I specialize in ASP.NET and C# on the .NET Framework with MS SQL Server. At Dynamic Technosoft I have built backends for ERP, school management, HRM, CRM and a multi-tenant scholarship platform used by 18+ local governments, working on REST APIs, role-based access control, PDF/Excel reporting and database performance. I have also worked part-time as a backend developer at Next Coach, an online learning platform for 1-on-1 mentorship, live classes and webinars, where I used Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL.
about.quote: Good backend work doesn't get noticed: the APIs are fast, the data is right, and the system keeps working as the business grows.
about.certifications: Certifications: Foundational C# (Microsoft), C# Class Development, and Introduction to Web Development with HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Education: BSc. CSIT, Trinity International College (Tribhuvan University), 2019 - 2024. Languages: Nepali, English, Newari and Hindi.

technicalExperience.description: Based in Shankhamul, Baneshwor. I build and maintain backends for the company's ERP products (Pivotal ERP, Academic ERP, HRM, CRM and ScholarshipERP) with ASP.NET, C# and MS SQL Server. My work includes REST APIs for web and mobile apps, optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, role-based authentication, PDF/Excel reports, and OneSignal push notifications.

Next Coach (learn.nextcoach.com.np) is an online learning platform for 1-on-1 mentorship, consultations, live classes and webinars with verified industry experts. I built server-side features and API routes with Next.js and TypeScript, and designed the PostgreSQL schema and data access with Prisma ORM for mentors, learners, sessions and classes.
I started on the ASP.NET backend team, building CRUD modules, SQL queries and API endpoints for ERP products while learning the team's layered architecture and code review process.

communityExperience.description: I was a project developer on this multi-tenant ASP.NET MVC application, which runs SEE scholarship programs for Metropolitan, Sub-Metropolitan and Municipal governments across Nepal (Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Pokhara, Birgunj, Bharatpur, Biratnagar, Janakpur, Dhangadhi and more) from one shared codebase. I built its flavor-based architecture, tenant-specific rules, dynamic routing and RBAC, along with modules for applications, student verification, school management, quota allocation, document uploads, approval workflows and reporting.

A scalable ASP.NET and SQL backend for inventory management, purchase and sales tracking, ledger-voucher creation and POS printing. It includes real-time notifications through OneSignal, PDF/Excel reports and chart dashboards (tables, pie, line and bar charts). I also worked on secure authentication, database query optimization and API performance.

I designed and built the backend for a school management system with separate roles for students, teachers, parents and drivers. It covers attendance, exam management, report generation and role-based access control, built with ASP.NET, SQL and AngularJS.

Secure, optimized backend APIs for employee data, attendance tracking, leave management and location monitoring. I also built role-based authentication, payroll data processing and data synchronization.
The backend for a CRM system covering lead management, customer interactions, sales tracking and automated notifications.

posts.title: Stop Guessing How Your App Looks on Other Devices — This Flutter Package Changed Everything.
posts.excerpt: As a Flutter developer, one of the biggest challenges I faced was ensuring that my app looked great on all devices. With so many different screen sizes and resolutions, it was nearly impossible to predict how my app would render on every device. That’s when I discovered the Flutter Device Preview package, and it completely changed the way I develop apps.
